title: Furnace Repair & Installation
shortDescription: Expert furnace repair and high-efficiency installation for Ontario winters.
fullDescription: When your furnace fails in the middle of an Oxford County winter, you need a team that responds fast and gets it right the first time. Optimum HVAC provides same-day furnace repair and professional high-efficiency furnace installation for homeowners across Woodstock, Ingersoll, Tillsonburg, and surrounding communities. We service all major brands including Lennox, Carrier, Trane, and Goodman.
features: High-efficiency gas furnace installation (up to 98% AFUE)
All major brands serviced and installed
10-year parts and labour warranty on new installs

faqs.question: How do I know if my furnace needs repair or replacement?
faqs.answer: If your furnace is over 15 years old, requires frequent repairs, or your energy bills have risen significantly, replacement is often more cost-effective. Our technicians will give you an honest assessment.

faqs.question: What brands of furnace do you install?
faqs.answer: We install Lennox, Carrier, Trane, Goodman, and Napoleon furnaces. We'll help you choose the right unit for your home size, budget, and efficiency goals.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing for furnace installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer flexible financing options including 0% interest plans through approved lenders. Ask us about current promotions.

title: Air Conditioner Repair & Installation
shortDescription: Keep cool all summer with expert AC service and new system installation.
fullDescription: Don't suffer through a southwestern Ontario summer with a failing air conditioner. Optimum HVAC provides fast AC repair and professional central air conditioner installation. We service all makes and models and can have a new high-efficiency system running in your home within days.
features: Same-day AC repair in most cases

faqs.question: My AC is running but not cooling. What's wrong?
faqs.answer: Common causes include low refrigerant, dirty coils, a failing compressor, or a clogged filter. Our technicians will diagnose the issue and provide an upfront quote before any work begins.

faqs.question: What SEER rating should I look for?
faqs.answer: In Ontario, we recommend a minimum SEER2 of 14.3 for good efficiency. Units rated 18+ SEER2 offer significant long-term savings and may qualify for rebates.

title: Heat Pump Installation
shortDescription: Year-round comfort with modern heat pumps — and up to $40,000 in government rebates.
fullDescription: Heat pumps are the most energy-efficient way to heat and cool your home. A single system replaces both your furnace and air conditioner, using electricity to move heat rather than burn fuel. Optimum HVAC specializes in heat pump installation across Oxford County and southwestern Ontario, and we'll help you navigate every available rebate program to maximize your savings.
features: Air source and ground source heat pump installation
Up to $40,000 in Canada Greener Homes rebates

faqs.question: Do heat pumps work in cold Canadian winters?
faqs.answer: Modern cold-climate heat pumps work efficiently down to -25°C or colder. Many systems include a backup electric or gas heat strip for extreme cold snaps, ensuring you're always comfortable.

faqs.question: What rebates are available for heat pumps in Ontario?
faqs.answer: The Canada Greener Homes Loan offers up to $40,000 interest-free. Enbridge HER+ provides $10,000+ for natural gas customers switching to heat pumps. Save on Energy offers additional incentives. We handle the paperwork for you.

faqs.question: How long does heat pump installation take?
faqs.answer: Most residential heat pump installations take one to two days. We handle permits, inspections, and rebate applications as part of our full-service installation.

title: Ductless Mini-Split Systems
shortDescription: Efficient zone-by-zone heating and cooling without ductwork.
fullDescription: Ductless mini-split systems are ideal for home additions, garages, older homes without ductwork, or any space where you want independent temperature control. Optimum HVAC installs Mitsubishi, Daikin, and Napoleon mini-splits — the quietest and most efficient units available.
features: Heating and cooling in one unit

faqs.question: Can a mini-split heat my whole house?
faqs.answer: A multi-zone mini-split system with multiple indoor heads can heat and cool an entire home. We'll assess your home's layout and recommend the right configuration.

title: Indoor Air Quality
shortDescription: Breathe cleaner air with whole-home filtration, humidifiers, and UV systems.
fullDescription: The air inside your home can be up to 5x more polluted than outdoor air. Optimum HVAC installs whole-home air purification systems, HRVs (heat recovery ventilators), humidifiers, dehumidifiers, and UV germicidal lights to dramatically improve indoor air quality for your family.
features: Carbon monoxide and air quality monitors

faqs.question: Do I need an HRV if I have a newer, airtight home?
faqs.answer: Yes — tightly built homes trap stale air, moisture, and pollutants. An HRV exchanges stale indoor air with fresh outdoor air while recovering up to 80% of the heat energy, keeping your home comfortable and healthy.

title: Tankless Water Heaters
shortDescription: Endless hot water and 30–40% energy savings with tankless water heater installation.
fullDescription: Upgrade from a conventional tank to a high-efficiency tankless water heater and enjoy endless hot water on demand — while cutting your water heating costs by 30–40%. Optimum HVAC installs Navien and Rinnai tankless units, which are TSSA G2 certified and backed by industry-leading warranties.

faqs.question: Can a tankless heater supply hot water to my whole home?
faqs.answer: Yes. We size the unit to your home's demand, accounting for the number of bathrooms, appliances, and simultaneous usage patterns to ensure you always have enough hot water.

title: Smart Thermostat Installation
shortDescription: Cut energy bills 15–23% with a professionally installed smart thermostat.
fullDescription: A smart thermostat learns your schedule, adjusts automatically, and lets you control your home's temperature from anywhere. Optimum HVAC installs and configures Ecobee and Nest thermostats, ensuring seamless integration with your existing HVAC system.
features: Integration with heat pumps and furnaces

faqs.question: Will any smart thermostat work with my heating system?
faqs.answer: Most smart thermostats are compatible with standard forced-air systems. Heat pumps, two-stage systems, and hydronic heating require specific models. We'll verify compatibility before installation.

title: HVAC Maintenance Plans
shortDescription: Annual tune-ups, priority service, and peace of mind — starting at $149/year.
fullDescription: Regular HVAC maintenance prevents costly breakdowns, extends equipment life, and keeps your systems running at peak efficiency. Optimum HVAC's maintenance plans include annual furnace and AC tune-ups, priority emergency service, and discounts on parts and repairs.

faqs.question: How often should I service my furnace and AC?
faqs.answer: We recommend annual service for both your furnace (in fall) and air conditioner (in spring). Regular tune-ups catch small issues before they become expensive breakdowns and keep your warranties valid.
